name: Corrina Cross
title: Communication and professional development trainer
bio_short: Communication and professional development trainer specialising in interpersonal skills, leadership and team effectiveness. Certified NLP Master Practitioner and DiSC consultant. Lead coach on Unilever's global development programme. Dubai-based.
bio: Corrina is a communication and professional development trainer specialising in interpersonal skills, leadership and workplace productivity. She is a certified NLP Master Practitioner, a facilitator of intercultural awareness and a behavioural style consultant using DiSC profiling tools to help individuals and teams understand their own communication patterns and work more effectively with others. She is also a qualified Mind Gym coach and Inter-Cultural Intelligence Certified.  Corrina qualified with the UK Chartered Institute of Marketing and built her career across several countries, living and working in Australia, Egypt and Bahrain before settling in Dubai. She previously worked in the corporate communications department at Emirates Group and managed a marketing agency in Dubai for 15 years before transitioning into learning and development. As one of the lead coaches, she contributed to the Management Development Programme for Unilever, delivering sessions globally.  At ISOC, Corrina delivers interpersonal skills, corporate communication, negotiation skills, presentation skills, cultural understanding and professional development programmes, together with executive coaching. Her approach combines behavioural science tools with practical, engaging facilitation. She is the Managing Partner and Lead Facilitator at The People People, where she partners with HR professionals to develop leaders with strong interpersonal skills. Her cross-cultural experience makes her particularly effective with diverse and multicultural groups. Corrina is based in Dubai and trains in English.
